findings.reason: without `a-queue-holds-the-whole-plan#s42` in §14's waits, the dogfood drain can launch on a batch path still costing about 3.5 minutes per entry, which changes both what the drain measures and what the plan claims is done.
findings.text: §42 is declared `implementable` but has no `plan-section-depends-on` key and no dependent, so §14 (`implementable`) can be dispatched in parallel with it even though §14's text says the drain starts "Once every other section has landed" and its loading beat is one `crew dispatch --batch` of at least 30 requests — the exact call §42 exists to make read each plan once; this is the same defect answered for §41 by adding `#s41` to §14's waits, recurring because §42 was added after that answer.

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `reckon/crew/admission/wait_refs.py:412-417` lands inside `section_edges` on the recursive `target()` call and the `_readiness._plan_state_and_text` read, `reckon/crew/admission/readiness.py:210-213` is the `_PASS_PLAN_STATES` held-cache lookup in `_persisted_plan_states`, and `reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py`, `metadata_index.covered_stat` and `authored_section_headings` all resolve.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the gate dispatches 20 entries over 4 plans with mutual waits and counts `metadata_index.discovery_state` calls and plan-heading parses against a bound of distinct plans, and names the base revision as its negative control, where the counts grow with entries, so the guard can fail; it also pins stored requests and waits to the base revision's for the same batch.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §42 puts every log under the run directory, a durable path, and names no scratchpad or node-local temporary location.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §42 adds no new symbol, and the code names it cites are existing modules and functions used as evidence, with no plan label or ticket number reaching a symbol.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated cause holds under inspection: `queue_batch` enters only `_parsed_once` and `_built_once`, `plan_read_scopes` is entered by `plan_dispatch` in `reckon/crew/dispatching/fences.py:286` and not by the batch, so `_PASS_PLAN_STATES` is unset inside `_persisted_plan_states` and each entry re-runs `metadata_index.discovery_state`, which loops every persisted entry through `covered_stat` as its docstring says it reads the store afresh per call; `readiness_cache` does reach `_validated_batch_waits` but is spent on `_readiness._readiness_rows` only, so no cache carries the plan reads; and the section names no code path, step sequence or formula, leaving the mechanism to the worker.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §42 delivers one thing, a batch reads each plan's state, text and headings at most once.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — §42 is now `implementable` but `plan-section-depends-on` carries no `s42` key and §14's declared waits still name only `#s40` and `#s41`, while §14's text starts the drain "Once every other section has landed" and §14's loading beat is exactly the `crew dispatch --batch` call §42 repairs.
